label: Bill introduced
notes: A measure has been formally introduced and assigned a bill number.

label: Referred to committee
notes: Committee referral sends the measure to the panel with jurisdiction before floor action.

label: Committee hearing
notes: The committee is gathering testimony or building a record; this is preparatory unless paired with markup or votes.

label: Committee markup/executive session
notes: The committee may amend and vote on whether to report the measure.

label: Reported by committee
notes: The committee has sent the measure back to the chamber, usually with a report or recommendation.

label: Discharged from committee
notes: The committee is bypassed or released from further consideration so the chamber can act.

label: Placed on calendar
notes: The measure is available on a calendar for possible floor consideration.

label: Motion to proceed
notes: The Senate is moving to take up a measure; this often signals leadership priority.

label: House message received
notes: The Senate has received House action or papers requiring Senate disposition.

label: Amendment pending
notes: An amendment is formally before the Senate and may shape the final text.

label: Substitute amendment pending
notes: A substitute can replace the underlying text and become the main legislative vehicle.

label: Amendment tree filled
notes: Available amendment slots are occupied, limiting further amendments absent consent or a vote.

label: Cloture filed
notes: Leadership has started the Rule XXII process to limit debate after the required interval.

label: Cloture invoked
notes: The Senate voted to limit debate, making final action more likely and timing more predictable.

label: Cloture rejected
notes: The Senate failed to limit debate, leaving the matter stalled unless leaders negotiate another path.

label: Vote scheduled
notes: A vote window has been announced; staffing and live coverage should be planned around it.

label: Passed Senate
notes: The Senate has passed the measure or agreed to a dispositive action.

label: Passed House
notes: The House has passed the measure or agreed to a dispositive action.

label: Conference requested
notes: One chamber is asking for a formal House-Senate conference to resolve differences.

label: Conferees appointed
notes: Members have been named to negotiate a conference report.

label: Conference report filed
notes: Negotiators have produced a final compromise text for chamber approval.

label: Conference report agreed to
notes: The chamber has adopted the conference report; both chambers must clear it before enrollment.

label: Enrolled bill
notes: The final passed text is being prepared for presidential presentation.

label: Presented to President
notes: The enrolled bill has been sent to the President for signature or veto decision.

label: Signed by President
notes: The President has signed the measure; it becomes law.

label: Vetoed
notes: The President has rejected the measure and returned it or issued a veto message.

label: Veto override
notes: The chamber is attempting or has completed a constitutionally required two-thirds override vote.

label: Quorum call
notes: A quorum call is often a holding pattern or timing device; by itself it is procedural noise unless paired with another action.

label: Recess
notes: A recess pauses floor proceedings; by itself it is routine timing information unless paired with a vote or leadership announcement.
